thread:
Sophia: Quick heads-up — scheduling press + analyst slots for the launch webinar next Tue. Need embargo window confirmed and final quote copy.
Matt: Can we keep embargo to 24h? Press vendors asked for at least a day.
Clare: 24h works for most US/EU outlets. APAC needs earlier cutoff if prebriefing - maybe 36h for analyst batch.
Sophia: Ok - proposal: analysts get 48h prebrief (can sign NDA), press 24h embargo. That way analysts can prep deep dives.
James: Agreed on analysts 48h. Do we have a list of who gets prebrief? @Clare can you gate? :eyes:
Clare: I'll filter - will include top 5 target analysts + a backup list. Sending list by EOD.
PressBot: Reminder: embargo metadata field must be included in the press kit: "embargo_until": "2024-06-18T16:00:00Z" if using ISO.
Sophia: Draft quote for CEO - please sanity-check:
```
"This launch makes inference predictable and affordable for teams running production LLMs," said Redwood CEO Ana Lopez. "Our focus is on latency, cost, and reliability so engineers can ship faster."
```
Matt: Could we tweak "predictable" -> "predictably fast and cost-efficient"? Feels clearer.
James: +1 to Matt. Also add a short analyst-friendly blurb about Dedicated and Private differences.
Clare: For fact-checks: ops will provide latency/cost bench links. Ops team - can you attach the 50/95/99 latency table and quantization notes?
PressBot: Factcheck request logged: ID #FK-2291. Please upload artifacts to /press/factchecks/FK-2291 by EOD tomorrow.
Sophia: Great. Last Q - timezone slots. We have 2 press briefing slots: 16:00 UTC and 03:00 UTC. Which one do we use for EU/US/APAC?
Matt: 16:00 UTC covers EU/US primetime. APAC we'll handle with recorded briefing + live APAC Q&A next morning.
Clare: OK I'll draft invites with both embargo and NDA notes, and include the quote variants. Will ping when invites go out.
James: Thanks - I'll prep the analyst slides and short FAQ.
Sophia: Sweet. If anyone wants to be on the prebrief list, ping @Clare now. :thumbsup:
